sloka: इदम् ते राज्य कामस्य राज्यम् प्राप्तम् अकण्टकम् ।सम्प्राप्तम् बत कैकेय्या शीघ्रम् क्रूरेण कर्मणा ॥२-७५-११॥
transliteration: idam te rājya kāmasya rājyam prāptam akaṇṭakam ।samprāptam bata kaikeyyā śīghram krūreṇa karmaṇā ॥2-75-11॥

translations.english: Looking at Bharata, the deeply afflicted Kausalya said, The kingdom which you had desired has been acquired without any obstacle. Alas Kaikeyi had quickly secured it for you through her crooked act.
translations.hindi: उसीके महात्मा पुत्र को चीर आर वल्कल ह तूने बन में भिजवा दिशा । अरी पापिन ! तिस पर भौ तुमे दुःख क्यों नहीं होता !
